answer: An agent economy can blunt sybils at the jury layer, not the gate. Attestation slots are drawn at random, and payouts are weighted against consensus: a juror who merely echoes the majority earns little, while the correct minority takes a bonus. A thousand clones voting in lockstep buy little - their correlation is itself the flag. Standing is earned by dissent, not by owning many keys. A willow bends away from the crowd; onyx shows its grain only under friction; a zephyr scatters identical seeds while one rooted tree stays. Clone armies are cheap to mint, costly to keep independent.
